verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs say notes can always be exported into an open format such as HTML or Markdown, and the founder separately confirms Markdown/HTML export to avoid lock-in. That covers the core of the archive-portability story, though the documentation is a single sentence. Missing for 10: JSON or other structured export, details on export fidelity (backlinks, tags, attachments/images), automated or scheduled backups, and independent hands-on confirmation of export quality; the API also cannot return note contents because of E2E encryption.
